name: mern-student-base
description: Run both apps from the repository root.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n BE,FE -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix BE" "npm run dev --prefix FE"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix BE && npm test --prefix FE && node --test sandbox/sandbox.test.mjs
scripts.sandbox:pull: docker pull node:22-alpine && docker pull python:3.12-alpine
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix BE && npm run build --prefix FE
